args.command:
cat /inputs/request.md && printf '
---catalog---
' && cat /inputs/tool-catalog.json && printf '
---selection---
' && cat /inputs/selection.json && printf '
---index---
' && cat /inputs/index-slice.json

cat /inputs/selection.json; jq -r '.tools[] | select((.id|ascii_downcase|contains("move")) or (.id|ascii_downcase|contains("transform")))' /inputs/tool-catalog.json; jq 'keys' /inputs/index-slice.json; cat /inputs/scene-context.json | head -c 3000

ls -la /work /outputs; find /work -path '*/change-set.schema.json' -print | head; jq '.nodes[] | select(.name == "Village Well")' /inputs/index-slice.json | head -c 3000; jq '.tools[] | select(.id=="move")' /inputs/tool-catalog.json

jq -e --slurpfile selection /inputs/selection.json --slurpfile scene /inputs/scene-context.json '(.id=="cs_01M4BVM1GN7FBSG51TG62JH6W3") and (.selection == ($selection[0] | {id,mode,indexRevision,targets})) and (.operations|length==1) and (.operations[0].target == (.baseVersions[0].ref)) and (.operations[0].args.position == [($scene[0].objects[0].position[0]+1),$scene[0].objects[0].position[1],$scene[0].objects[0].position[2]]) and (.operations[0].applyRequirement=="Rebuild") and (.artifacts==[])' /outputs/changeset.json >/dev/null && echo 'JSON and move validated'; find /outputs -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n'

outcome.text:
JSON and move validated
